Resolves #19250

A torn-out vessel's provisional chrome — the tab strip it shows from birth until its terminal — is now the same compact inline dock strip the committed projection mounts in its place. `resolveVesselStageTarget` creates the `DockTabContainer` with the projection's own pair, `ui: 'inline'` and `neo-dashboard-dock-tabs`; before, without them, the header fell to the stock 48 px button floor (the operator's recording at 00:03 and 00:12).

Evidence: L2 (headless, same tree: the pre-terminal vessel's toolbar / button measure 33 / 32 px at this head, 49 / 48 on dev; the committed popup measures 33 / 32 on both) → L2 required (AC-2). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs run in CI.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — two config lines in one factory and two assertions in the arm that already pins that factory; no engine line.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/Workspace.spec.mjs` › "a vessel's stage target is a provisional tab chrome…" asserts `ui === 'inline'` and the `neo-dashboard-dock-tabs` class — red with dev's `VesselWorkspace.mjs` over this head, green here (89 passed). |
| AC-2 | Headless measurement (untracked scratch spec, driver tear-out with a 3.5 s birth dwell): pre-terminal `.neo-tab-header-toolbar` 33 px / button 32 px at +300 ms, +900 ms, +1800 ms; committed popup 33 / 32. On dev: 49 / 48 pre-terminal, 33 / 32 committed. |
| AC-3 | CI `unit` job. |

None substantive — the container's classes alone carry the compact height; no host wrapper was needed.
